note: Unofficial fan guide. Not affiliated with Rockstar Games, Sony or PlayStation. Trophy names and descriptions are as PlayStation publishes them (official list via Exophase, as reported by Push Square). Guide text is written in our own words; each trophy cites its sources.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum unlocks itself once the other 54 trophies are earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. Work through the roadmap stages in order (story, then heists and duo work, then the open-world grind, then cleanup) and this pops last. If it does not pop, one trophy is still missing: use the tracker's filters to find which one.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (reported by Push Square)

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, which introduces Lucia and Jason. It is the first story mission of the game and cannot be missed — just follow the on-screen prompts through the fishing trip until the mission-complete screen appears.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (reported by Push Square)

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Play through every story mission in Chapter 1 until the chapter closes. Before you leave Chapter 1, meditate at the Chapter 1 meditation spot (see Positive Mental Attitude) — it is the one thing in the game that may not come back later.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (reported by Push Square)

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish all story missions in Chapter 2. Chapter trophies unlock in order as the story advances, so there is no special trick here — keep playing the gold mission markers until the chapter ends.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (reported by Push Square)

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish all story missions in Chapter 3. By now the map has opened up: resist the urge to chase every side activity at once — the roadmap keeps collectibles and grinding for Stage 3, after the story is done, so you stay focused here.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (reported by Push Square)

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish all story missions in Chapter 4. Once this pops you are into the endgame stretch: finish the final mission next (You Gotta Know When to Get Off) and then move to Stage 2 of the roadmap, the heist and duo-work trophies.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (reported by Push Square)

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the game's final story mission. It is a gold trophy and the natural end of Stage 1. Nothing about the ending locks you out of the open world afterwards — post-story free roam is where Stages 2 to 4 happen, so do not worry about rushing side content before the finale.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (reported by Push Square)

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It unlocks as part of the main story path, so it pops naturally while you play through the chapters — no side requirement and nothing to prepare in advance.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (reported by Push Square)

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions are the big set-pieces of the story: follow the planning steps the game gives you, and the trophy pops on the mission-complete screen.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (reported by Push Square)

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Like the other mission trophies it is unmissable story progress — it pops when the mission ends, so just keep following the story.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (reported by Push Square)

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Another story-progress trophy: play the mission to its conclusion and it unlocks with the mission-complete screen.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (reported by Push Square)

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown at Vice City International Airport. The mission takes you into the airport grounds — the same area the Catch Me If You Can trophy plays with later, so you will already know the layout when you come back for that one.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (reported by Push Square)

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. A late-story mission trophy that pops on completion — no extra objective is needed beyond finishing the mission itself.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (reported by Push Square)

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion on the in-game stats screen — the gold trophy that sits beside the platinum as the last big milestone. It counts story missions, stranger strands, collectibles, activities and the counted challenges together, so it only pops when Stage 4 cleanup is genuinely finished. Check the in-game 100% checklist to see which category is still short, then use this tracker's filters to find the matching trophies.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (reported by Push Square)

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts — jumps, near misses, wheelies, drifts and air time all count toward the total. The count builds up naturally across a full playthrough, but to grind it fast find a long straight with ramps or a stunt jump you can repeat, and use a fast bike or car. The in-game stats screen tracks your stunt total, so check there before assuming you are close.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (reported by Push Square)

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once — fishing, golf, bowling, darts, arcade games, shooting range, races, drone races and meditation are the kinds the guide tracks. You only need to try each one, not win or finish it, so sample them early in Stage 3 and tick them off as you go. If one type has not registered, re-check that you actually started the activity rather than just walking past its location.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (reported by Push Square)

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges at the gun ranges around Leonida. Each challenge has its own gold score threshold — take your time, use a steady aim, and replay a challenge as many times as you need; there is no penalty for retrying. Work through them range by range and mark each gold in the tracker as you earn it.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (reported by Push Square)

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations across Leonida. Drone races are short and repeatable, so a lost race costs you nothing but a retry. Learn each course's corners on a first slow run, then race it properly — winning at a location once is all that counts.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (reported by Push Square)

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — street races, off-road races and water races all count, as long as each one is a different race event. You do not need to win the same race twice; spread out across the map and take the wins one event at a time. Races you already won during the story count toward the 20.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (reported by Push Square)

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges are head-to-head: land the bigger catch or the higher total before the timer ends. Use the best rod and bait you have, watch the line tension so it never snaps, and challenge Cal again if he wins the first round — the challenge can be retried.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (reported by Push Square)

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game at any arcade cabinet in Leonida. Any game counts and you only need to finish one run of it — pick the cabinet you find easiest, learn its controls for a minute, then play it through to the end screen.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (reported by Push Square)

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Andy's stranger mission strand. Stranger missions appear as question-mark markers on the map — follow Andy's strand through each of his missions until his last one is done. If his marker has not appeared yet, keep playing the story: stranger strands unlock as the chapters advance.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (reported by Push Square)

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Kenton's stranger mission strand. Work through his missions in order from his map marker; the strand ends with his last mission, and the trophy pops when it is complete.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (reported by Push Square)

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Billy's stranger mission strand. Billy's missions are biker-themed, so keep a good bike handy for his strand. Finish his last mission and the trophy is yours.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (reported by Push Square)

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full stranger mission strands across Leonida. Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone each have their own strand with its own trophy, so those five already count toward the eight — finish three more stranger strands and the silver pops. Stranger markers appear on the map as the story advances; sweep the map for question marks in Stage 2.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (reported by Push Square)

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Randy's stranger mission strand. Follow his marker through each of his missions in order until the strand's last mission is done.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (reported by Push Square)

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Tyrone's stranger mission strand. Play his missions in order from his map marker; the trophy pops on his final mission's completion screen.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (reported by Push Square)

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. MISSABLE WARNING: one meditation spot sits in the Chapter 1 area and may vanish once Chapter 1 ends — meditate there BEFORE you finish Chapter 1, or the trophy may be locked out for that playthrough. The other 17 spots stay available in free roam, so sweep them in Stage 3 and tick each one off in the tracker as you go. Use the Missable filter in this guide to find this trophy fast if you are mid-Chapter 1.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (reported by Push Square)

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks you to track down. Bret's strand is a hunting one: follow his marker, track the animal using the clues the game gives you, and take the shot cleanly when you find it. Bring a scoped rifle and approach quietly — spooking the animal sends you back to tracking it again.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (reported by Push Square)

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida — in shops, on tables, tucked into corners of buildings. You only need 3 complete sets, not every card in the game, so pick the sets you are closest to finishing and hunt their missing cards. PowerPyx's guide maps the card locations set by set.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (reported by Push Square)

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK It feature at 100 different locations around Leonida. Each new location counts once, so keep moving — revisiting the same spot adds nothing. The fastest route is a road trip around the state, stopping at every town, landmark and beach along the way; the count climbs steadily as you explore.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (reported by Push Square)

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges from the game's challenge list — the short goals the game tracks under stats (stunts, kills with a weapon type, distances driven, and similar). Pick the easy ones first and let the rest accumulate while you play: most players clear 50 without a dedicated grind once they start checking the list. Open the challenge list in-game to see which ones are nearest done.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (reported by Push Square)

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build up a 4-star wanted level and then lose the cops completely. The trick is the escape, not the wanted level: get the 4 stars, then drive to a quiet corner of the map — the swamps and back roads work well — break line of sight, and wait for the stars to blink out. Do it with your partner in the car or on foot next to you, or it will not count.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (reported by Push Square)

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row without ever losing your wanted level — the chain breaks if the cops lose you between robberies. Pick three shops close together on the same street, rob each one fast, and keep moving to the next before the wanted level drops. A fast getaway car parked outside the third shop helps you escape afterwards.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (reported by Push Square)

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles — drive or ride each one and it counts as discovered. Variety is the whole game here: steal everything you see, from scooters to trucks to boats, and check the in-game vehicle list to see what is still missing. Parking lots, the airport and the docks are the best hunting grounds for models you have not tried yet.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (reported by Push Square)

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during one single use of Combat Focus. Wait for a fight with a big group — a gang hideout or a wanted-level shootout — then trigger Combat Focus when five or more enemies are in view and drop them all before the effect ends. A fast-firing weapon and good cover make the difference; if you only get four, reload the checkpoint and try again.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (reported by Push Square)

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure from Vice City International Airport — in plain terms, steal a plane and take off without going through the normal gates. Get onto the runway area, grab a small plane, and get airborne. You will pick up a wanted level for the runway intrusion, so climb fast and fly clear of the airport before the cops catch up.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (reported by Push Square)

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — the exact method for this trophy is not confirmed yet. The description hints at the Rhino tank ('Kinda hot in these Rhinos'), so it is likely tied to driving or surviving in a Rhino tank, but no source we checked states the trigger plainly. Do not chase this one on a guess: check PowerPyx's guide or the GTA Zone list for an update first, then attempt it once the method is confirmed.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (reported by Push Square)

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected at any point. Go in quiet: no alarms, no witnesses calling the cops, no camera spotting you. Plan the route in first — scope the store during the day, then hit it at night when fewer people are around. If an alarm trips, leave and retry; a detected run never counts.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (reported by Push Square)

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Each vault is its own job: get in, crack or blow the vault, grab the cash, and get clear of the wanted level before the next. Space them out — there is no need to do all five in one session — and keep a fast car stashed near each bank for the getaway.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (reported by Push Square)

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks drive set routes around the city — follow one until it stops or slows in traffic, block it in, crack the rear doors, take the cash, and lose the wanted level. A sticky bomb on the doors is the classic opener, but any way in counts as long as you escape with the money.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (reported by Push Square)

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. The in-game map tracks which areas you have visited — open it and look for the parts still greyed out or unvisited, then drive, fly or sail to each one. The islands and the far corners of the swamps are the ones players miss most, so save those for a deliberate sweep at the end of Stage 3.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (reported by Push Square)

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs in Leonida. Each gang runs its own rackets — drug labs, chop shops, smuggling docks — marked on the map once you find them. Hit one operation per gang and the trophy pops; the in-game stats or gang list shows which gangs you have already hit, so check it before repeating a gang.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (reported by Push Square)

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to Ocean Beach, order a cocktail at a beach bar, and enjoy the view. It is a quiet moment trophy: sit at the bar, buy the drink, and let the scene play. Ocean Beach is on the Vice City shoreline — any beachfront bar with a sea view should do it.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (reported by Push Square)

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Drive a car through the front window of a vehicle showroom and out the other side — the classic GTA showroom smash. Pick a showroom with big glass fronts, build up speed on the street outside, and drive straight through. The trophy is about the style of the exit, so commit to it: hesitate halfway and you will just be stuck in a showroom with a wanted level.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (reported by Push Square)

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play a game of bowling at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and follow through on your shots. You do not need a high score — just complete a game there. The alley is the dedicated bowling venue in the city; rent a lane, play through the frames, and the trophy pops at the end of the game.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (reported by Push Square)

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — the exact method for this trophy is not confirmed yet. The description ('A partnership with mass appeal') suggests something done with your partner that draws a crowd or goes public, but no source we checked states the trigger plainly. Do not chase this one on a guess: check PowerPyx's guide or the GTA Zone list for an update first.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (reported by Push Square)

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — the exact method for this trophy is not confirmed yet. The description ('Choices made') suggests it tracks decisions across the game, and PlayStation reportedly tracks a count toward 500 for it, but no source we checked states plainly which choices count or what the trigger is. Do not grind choices blindly: check PowerPyx's guide or the GTA Zone list for an update first.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (reported by Push Square)

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — the exact method for this trophy is not confirmed yet. The description ('Second time's the charm') suggests succeeding at something on a second attempt, but no source we checked states plainly which attempt counts. Do not chase this one on a guess: check PowerPyx's guide or the GTA Zone list for an update first.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (reported by Push Square)

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — the exact method for this trophy is not confirmed yet. The description ('What the hell just happened?') points at some strange random event in the world, but no source we checked states plainly which event triggers it. Keep playing and exploring — strange encounters tend to find you — and check PowerPyx's guide or the GTA Zone list for an update rather than hunting blind.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (reported by Push Square)

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone over with a melee drive-by — hit a pedestrian with a melee weapon while driving past. Get a car up to a moderate speed, roll down the window side toward a pedestrian, and swing as you pass. It takes a little timing: too slow and you miss, too fast and the swing whiffs. A quiet street with walkers is the easiest place to line it up.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (reported by Push Square)

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from heists and robberies — they cannot be spent directly, so take them to a laundering contact and convert them into clean cash. The total is cumulative across the whole game, so every robbery and vault job feeds it; keep laundering after each big score and the $250,000 adds up on its own.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (reported by Push Square)

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops in Leonida — clothes, weapons, food, car mods, anything bought in a shop counts toward the total. It is cumulative, so normal play covers much of it: buy the gear you actually want, upgrade your favourite cars, and the total climbs. Check the in-game stats to see how much you have spent so far.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (reported by Push Square)

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties across Leonida. Garages go on sale through the in-game property sites and signs — each one costs money, so save up during Stage 3 and buy them in Stage 4 cleanup. Owning a garage also gives you somewhere to store the rare vehicles you need for Whip It Good, so the two trophies pair well.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (reported by Push Square)

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app on your in-game phone. Open the app, pick a vehicle you own or have found, and register it — repeat for 10 different vehicles. Any 10 vehicles count, so use the ones already sitting in your garages first, then grab a few more off the street if you are short.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (reported by Push Square)
